transactions.desc: The White Sox recalled Quero from Triple-A Charlotte on Thursday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
Wilson (back) was activated from the 60-day injured list and designated for assignment by the Rays on Thursday, per the MLB.com transaction log.
The Phillies outrighted Henry to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Thursday after he cleared waivers.
The Red Sox released La Sorsa on Thursday.
The Tigers released Lequerica on Thursday, Emily Waldon of Baseball America reports.
Kimbrel cleared waivers Thursday and elected to become a free agent, Marc Topkin of the Tampa Bay Times reports.
The Cardinals claimed Pereira off waivers from the White Sox on Thursday.
Hernandez re-signed Tuesday with Atlanta on a minor-league contract.
The Royals claimed  Little off waivers from the Cubs on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Omaha.
The Reds claimed  Solesky off waivers from the Rays on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Louisville.
The Nationals claimed  Mills off waivers from the Dodgers on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Rochester.
The Astros optioned Dezenzo to Triple-A Sugar Land on Thursday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
Rodriguez cleared waivers Thursday and was sent outright to Triple-A Nashville, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Athletics outrighted Zhuang to Triple-A Las Vegas on Tuesday.
The Cubs optioned Ferguson to Triple-A Iowa on Thursday, Jared Wyllys of AllCHGO.com reports.
The Cubs recalled Garrett from Triple-A Iowa on Thursday, Jared Wyllys of AllCHGO.com reports.
The Angels promoted Bremner from High-A Tri-City to Double-A Rocket City on Tuesday.
The Miami Marlins traded INF Adrian Santana to the Tampa Bay Rays.
The Pirates selected Simon's contract from Triple-A Indianapolis on Wednesday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Abner from Triple-A Reno on Wednesday, Jody Jackson of DBacks.tv reports.
The Diamondbacks optioned Del Castillo to Triple-A Reno on Wednesday, Jody Jackson of Bally Sports Arizona reports.
Moreno (personal) was reinstated from the paternity list and will bat cleanup as the Diamondbacks' designated hitter in Wednesday's game against the Padres, Jody Jackson of DBacks.tv reports.
The Brewers reinstated Harrison (forearm) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Wednesday versus the Pirates.
The Nationals designated Littell for assignment Wednesday.
Cincinnati recalled Mey from Triple-A Louisville on Wednesday.
Washington activated Lord (side) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Padres designated Marquez for assignment Wednesday.
The Angels recalled Saucedo from Triple-A Salt Lake on Wednesday.
The Blue Jays claimed Waldron off waivers from the Padres on Wednesday.
Milwaukee optioned Anderson to Triple-A Nashville on Wednesday.
